question: How much can I claim per kilometre when I use my own car for work?

supplied.heading: 4. Claims and expenses > 4.1 What you can claim
supplied.text:
You may claim money you spent for company business when it was approved before the trip or purchase. The rates below apply to every employee.
Expense: Mileage, own car; Rate or limit: RM0.70 per km; Evidence needed: Trip log with start, end and purpose
Expense: Meal allowance, outstation; Rate or limit: RM30 per day; Evidence needed: Outstation for more than 8 hours; no receipt
Expense: Hotel, one night; Rate or limit: Up to RM180 in Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan or Tawau; up to RM150 elsewhere; Evidence needed: Hotel invoice
Expense: Flights; Rate or limit: Economy class, booked by the admin office; Evidence needed: Booking confirmation
Expense: Toll and parking; Rate or limit: Actual cost; Evidence needed: Receipt or e-wallet statement
Expense: Mobile phone, sales staff; Rate or limit: RM50 per month; Evidence needed: None, paid with salary

supplied.heading: 4. Claims and expenses > 4.2 How and when to claim
supplied.text:
- Submit the claim form in the finance portal within 30 days of the date you spent the money. Claims older than 30 days are not paid.
- Claims approved by the 20th of the month are paid with that month's salary. Claims approved after the 20th are paid in the next month.
- A cash advance of up to RM1,000 can be requested for a trip. Settle it with receipts within 7 days of returning, or it is deducted from salary.

supplied.heading: 4. Claims and expenses > 4.1 What you can claim
supplied.text: Any single item above RM10 needs a receipt. Claims without a receipt are paid only if the Finance Manager accepts a written reason.

supplied.heading: 4. Claims and expenses > 4.3 Who approves
supplied.text:
Claim total: Up to RM500; Approved by: Your supervisor
Claim total: RM500.01 to RM2,000; Approved by: Your department head
Claim total: More than RM2,000; Approved by: The General Manager
